Item.Hint: Enter result code used by Client Blood Center.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/07/2011. IM 5356
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 /* invalid date is trapped by On-error. on-error routine will popup an
 error screen, if you try to display another error using show-error. 
 On-error is invoked the first time that the contents of the date field
 is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors
 using the on-error checks */
 
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:Rgt_results_matrix.eff_date, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');
 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT') 
 then
 if :eff_date < trunc(v_local_time) 
 then -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/07/2011. IM 5356
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
exception 
 when value_error 
 then
 show_error('1706');
 check_package_failure;
 when others 
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUPLICATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_duplicate IS
begin
 select DISTINCT 'x' into :global.x
 from rgt_results_matrix a
 where a.test_id = :rgt_results_matrix.test_id and
 a.result_status = :result_status and
 contract_id = :ctrl_block_1.contract_id and
 -- chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id and -- MLT 2305
 (rowid != :rgt_results_matrix.rowid or
 :rgt_results_matrix.rowid is null);
 show_error('1023');
exception when no_data_found then
 null;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: RGT_RESULTS_RESULT_STAT_LOV3
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct a.result_status, substr(b.code_desc,1,39) 
from valid_test_results a,master_codes b 
where lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,a.eff_date,a.term_date,sysdate) = 'Y' and 
a.test_id = :rgt_results_matrix.test_id and 
b.code_type = 'RESUL' and 
b.code = a.result_status and 
a.result_status not in (
select result_status 
from rgt_results_matrix 
where contract_id = :ctrl_block_1.contract_id and chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id and (eff_date between Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:ctrl_block_1.chapter_id,sysdate) and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) or
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,a.eff_date,a.term_date,sysdate) = 'Y' ))
